spans.s: पुंस् vt. 10U (pres. पुंसयति-ते) 1. To crush, to grind; 2. to punish.

पुंस् m. (nom. पुमान्-मांसौ-मांसः; voc. sing. पुमन्) 1. Man, mankind, वंद्यैः पुंसां रघुपतिपदैरंकितं मेखलासु Megh.i.12; 2. a male, a male being; 3. a man, यदृच्छाशब्दवत्पुंसः संज्ञायै जन्म केवलम् Sis.ii.47; 4. a servant, an attendant; 5. a word in the masculine gender; 6. the soul.
पुंसानुज a. having an elder brother.
पुंस्-कटि f. a man’s hip.
पुंस्-कामा f. a woman wishing for a husband.
पुंस्-कोकिल m. a male cuckoo, K.S.iii.32.
पुंखेट m. a male planet.
पुंगव m. 1. a bull, an ox; 2. (at the end of a compound) the chief, best, most excellent of any kind, गजपुंगवस्तु धीरं विलोकयति चाटुशतैश्च भुंक्ते Bhartr.ii.31.
पुंगव˚केतु m. an epithet of Śiva.
पुंश्चली f. a harlot, an unchaste woman, Yaj.i.162.
पुंश्चलीय m. the son of a harlot.
पुंश्चिह्न n. the characteristic of a male, i.e. membrum virile.
पुंजन्मन् n. the birth of a male child.
पुंजन्मन्˚योग m. a constellation under which male children are born.
पुंस्त्व n. 1. the state of a male, masculineness, virility; 2. semen virile; 3. the masculine gender (in gram.).
पुंदास m. a male slave.
पुंध्वज m. 1. the male of any species of animal; 2. a mouse.
पुंनक्षत्र n. a male asterism.
पुंनाग m. 1. a white elephant; 2. a white lotus; 3. nutmeg; 4. name of a tree (नागकेशर), R.vi.57; 5. a distinguished man.
पुंनाट m. name of a tree.
पुंनाट m. name of a tree.
पुंनामधेय m. a male.
पुंनामन् (I) a. having a masculine name.
पुंनामन् (II) m. the punnāga tree.
पुत्-नामन् m. the same as पुत् q.v.
पुंस्-पुत्र m. a male child.
पुंस्-प्रजनन n. the male organ of genaration.
पुंभूमन् m. a word of the masculine gender used in the plural number only, (e.g. दार).
पुंयोग m. cohabitation with men.
पुंरत्न n. an excellent man.
पुंराशि m. a male sign of the zodiac.
पुंरूप m. the form of a man.
पुंल्लिंग (I) a. masculine.
पुंल्लिंग (II) n. 1. manhood, virility; 2. the masculine gender (in gram.).
पुंवत् ind. like a man, R.vi.20.
पुंवत्स m. a bull-calf.
पुंवृष m. the musk-rat.
पुंवेष a. wearing male attire.
पुंसवन n. 1. a religious ceremony held on a woman’s perceiving the first signs of a living conception, R.iii.10; 2. fetus; 3. milk.
पुंख m.n. 1. The feathered part of an arrow, R.ii.31, iii.64, ix.61; 2. a falcon, a heron.
पुंखित a. (f. ता) Furnished with feathers (as an arrow).
पुंखित a. (f. ता) Furnished with feathers (as an arrow).
पुंग m.n. A heap, a collection.
पुंगल m. The soul.
पुंज m. A heap, a multitude, a mass, a collection, चल सखि कुंजं सतिमिरिपुंजं शीलय नीलनिचोलम् Git.G.v., K.S.vii.26.
पुंजि f. A heap, a quantity.
पुंजिक m. Hail.
पुंजित a. (f. ता) 1. Heaped, heaped together; 2. pressed together.
पुंजित a. (f. ता) 1. Heaped, heaped together; 2. pressed together.
पुंड m. A mark, a sign.

पुंडरीक (I) m. 1. Name of the elephant presiding over the south-east quarter, R.xviii.8; 2. a fever in an elephant; 3. the white colour; 4. a tiger; 5. a kind of leprosy; 6. a kind of mango tree; 7. a species of rice; 8. a pitcher, a water pot; 9. fire; 10. a mark on the forehead.
पुंडरीक (II) n. 1. A lotus flower, R.xviii.8; 2. a white umbrella.
पुंडरीक-अक्ष m. an epithet of Viṣṇu, R.xviii.8.
पुंडरीक-प्लव m. a kind of bird.
पुंडरीक-मुखी f. a kind of leech.
पुंड्र (I) m. 1. A kind of sugarcane; 2. a lotus, especially a white lotus; 3. a mark on the forehead; 4. a worm.
पुंड्र (II) m. pl. Name of a country and its inhabitants.
पुंड्र-केलि m. an elephant.
पुंड्रक m. 1. A variety of sugarcane; 2. a mark on the forehead.

पुनर् ind. 1. Again, once more, निवार्यतामालि किमप्ययं वटुः पुनर्विवक्षुः K.S.v.82, iii.69, R.i.86, ii.23; 2. on the other hand, but, on the contrary, nevertheless, however, अथवा काममननुरूपमस्या वपुषो वल्कलं न पुनरलंकाराश्रियं न पुष्णाति Sak.i.पुनरपि 1. even, again, also; 2. and, on the other hand.किंपुनः ‘how much more, how much less,’ Megh.i.17.पुनःपुनः ‘again and again, repeatedly,’ पुनःपुनः सूतनिषिद्धचापलं हरंतमश्वं रथरश्मिसंयतम् R.iii.42.(पुनर्गम् ‘to go back.’ पुनर्दा ‘to give back.’ पुनर्भू ‘to become a wife again.’)
पुनर्-अर्थिता f. repeated request.
पुनर्-आगत a. returned, come back.
पुनर्-आगम m. return.
पुनर्-आधान, -आधेय n. renewing a consecrated fire.
पुनर्-आधान, -आधेय n. renewing a consecrated fire.
पुनर्-आवृत्, -आवृत्ति f. 1. repetition; 2. revision; 3. return to mundane existence, Yaj.iii.194.
पुनर्-आवृत्, -आवृत्ति f. 1. repetition; 2. revision; 3. return to mundane existence, Yaj.iii.194.
पुनर्-उक्त (I) a. 1. repeated, reiterated; 2. superfluous.
पुनर्-उक्त (II) n. 1. repetition; 2. uselessness, tautology.
पुनर्-उक्त˚जन्मन् m. a Brāhmaṇa.

पुनर्-उक्त˚वदाभास m. a figure of speech consisting in the appearance of tautology, the first impression being removed by a right understanding of the passage, e.g. अरिवधेदहशरीरः सहसारथिसूततुरगपादातः । भाति सदानत्यागः स्थिरतायामवनितलतिलकः K.Pr.ix.
पुनर्-उक्ति f. 1. repetition; 2. tautology, i.e. uselessness.
पुनर्-उत्थान n. resurrection.
पुनर्-उत्पत्ति f. 1. reproduction; 2. metempsychosis.
पुनर्-उपगम m. return, क्वायोध्यायाः पुनरुपगमो दंडकायां वने वः Ut.ii.
पुनर्-उपोढा f. A woman married again.
पुनर्-गमन n. return.
पुनर्-जन्मन् n. metempsychosis.
पुनर्-जात a. born again.
पुनर्-णव, -नव m. a finger-nail.
पुनर्-णव, -नव m. a finger-nail.
पुनर्-दारक्रिया f. taking a second wife.
पुनःप्रत्युपकार m. requital, retaliation.
पुनर्-भव m. 1. transmigration, repeated birth, ममाफि च क्षपयतु नीललोहितः पुनर्भवं परिगतशक्तिरारात्मभूः Sak.vii., K.S.iii.5; 2. a finger-nail.
पुनर्भाव m. new birth.
पुनर्भू f. 1. a virgin widow remarried; 2. re-existence.
पुनर्यात्रा f. a repeated procession.
पुनर्-वसु m. 1. (generally du.) the 7th lunar mansion consisting of four stars, गां गताविव दिवः पुनर्वसू R.xi.36; 2. an epithet of Viṣṇu; 3. of Śiva.
पुनर्-विवाह m. second marriage.
पुनःसंस्कार m. repetition of any purificatory ceremony.
पुनःसंधान n. reuniting.
पुनःसंभव m. coming into existence again, metempsychosis.
पून a. (f. ना) Destroyed.
पून a. (f. ना) Destroyed.
